author: Top Gear
description:
This is a Land Rover Defender as you’ve never seen it before. In fact, it’s barely a Land Rover at all, rather it’s the world’s first ‘hyper truck’, thanks to a mid-mounted and twin-turbocharged V8 that produces 1200hp on pump gas and 1500hp on E85! It’s the creation of Joe Scarbo, it’s called the Scarbo SV Rover, and we’ve been for a poke around it and a passenger ride. Land Rover Defender Octa owners, meet the new boss…
